question: What share of adults ate no meat, poultry or fish on recall days that fell on lunar 1st or 15th, against other days, in the 2021 Viet Nam DQQ round? And the same by age and income group?
why_it_matters: Gives the first revealed estimate of chay-day keeping (R2 keeper share and days) and of who keeps them; tests ch22 2.5% avoided meat protein
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the Global Diet Quality Project or Gallup for a tabulation by interview date (microdata are licensed, not public)
owner_org_to_ask: Global Diet Quality Project (GAIN, Harvard); Gallup

question: Can the next Viet Nam DQQ round, or the next NIN nutrition survey, add giò, chả and nem chua to the processed-meat item and add a chay-day item?
why_it_matters: Only national instrument that could test R3 (processed-meat share) and R2 (chay days) at low cost
cheapest_way_to_close: Propose the wording to the Global Diet Quality Project and the National Institute of Nutrition
owner_org_to_ask: Global Diet Quality Project; National Institute of Nutrition

question: Under which Vietnamese customs heading, and by which importers, is the post-October 2023 flow that China declares as HS 3504 (about 25,000 t at about USD 1 per kg in 2024) recorded?
why_it_matters: Decides whether the 2024 jump is feed or technical protein (R1 food pool about 35 kt) or food isolate (about 40 kt); Viet Nam recorded only 38% of the Q4 2023 value as 3504
cheapest_way_to_close: Declaration-level customs data (DMV-02); or Comtrade calls for further Viet Nam headings from China once the server is stable
owner_org_to_ask: Viet Nam customs (General Department of Customs); researchers with declaration data

question: Has any startup or small maker sold a protein ingredient (textured protein, fungal or pulse protein) to Vietnamese chay makers, meat processors or caterers, and what happened?
why_it_matters: The ingredient route Part VI recommends has no founder test in the firm register
cheapest_way_to_close: Five calls to chay makers (An Nhien, Au Lac, Thoai An) and to the distributor ACC

question: Are VMEAT, Is It Meat?, Yukino Foods, Bien Phuong, Karana, Float Foods, Phuture and Meatiply still registered and trading?
why_it_matters: Firms up 8 of 11 dormant statuses in the base rates
cheapest_way_to_close: Business registry lookups (Viet Nam national business registration portal; Singapore company registry; Malaysia company registry)

question: Did the 2025 Vu Lan season show the same pre-season rise in textured protein imports?
why_it_matters: Confirms the seasonal signal in a year with a late 7th lunar month (starting 23 Aug 2025)
cheapest_way_to_close: Viet Nam customs monthly statistics or Comtrade once 2025 monthly data are loaded
